title: Eggshells
author: William Saville
content:
Closed doors,
Slammed and walls shaken,
Feelings awoken,
And thoughts forsaken.
Tiptoe and hold breath,
To avoid another fight,
Eggshells on floor,
A minefield in plain sight.
Hide my true self,
To be loved is what I've known,
I'm too much and too loud,
So many untruths I've sewn.
Too wary to knock down,
These walls I've built so high,
I've been taught to hide,
I've been taught to lie.
Hammer and chisel,
The trauma away from truth,
To unbury myself,
From the lies from my youth.
I am enough all on my own,
I'm not too much or too loud,
I am a good person,
Done many things of which to be proud.
I can be more than this,
A placeholder for better things,
Or a doormat to be walked on,
It's time I've grown my wings.
I can just breathe and feel worthy,
Of every breath I take,
My trauma and past don't define me,
This path is one that I make.
From here on out it is mine,
I promise to love myself,
With strength and without prejudice,
I vow to find my own wealth.
